# Alliance Handyman Pros

## Who We Are
Alliance Handyman Pros is a local install and mounting specialist serving Fairfield County, Connecticut and lower Westchester County, New York. We are owner operated, not a franchise and not a tech support aggregator. We know the local housing stock: plaster and lath walls in older colonials, stone and brick fireplaces, tile and fiberglass bathrooms, and high rise condos.

## Services
- **TV Mounting**: standard wall mounts on drywall, brick, stone, and above the fireplace. $199 for TVs up to 65 inches on drywall. TVs 66 to 70 inches are $200 and 86 inches and larger are $385. Above the fireplace installs start at $250. Indoor brick, stone or concrete adds $120. The mount is not included; we bring one for $85 if needed. Soundbar mounting is $85, a device hidden behind the TV is $90, and an additional TV in the same visit is $150.
- **Outdoor TV Mounting**: patios, decks and outdoor living spaces. Starts at $540.
- **Samsung Frame Installation**: no gap mounting, One Connect cable routing, wire concealment. Starts at $400.
- **Wire and Cable Concealment**: fixed add-on prices with a TV mount. Exterior cord cover $50, in wall concealment $175, through a fireplace wall $250.
- **Furniture Assembly**: IKEA, Wayfair, West Elm, Pottery Barn, Restoration Hardware, Crate and Barrel, Article, and CB2. Flat rate per visit, wall anchoring included on tall pieces.
- **IKEA Assembly**: PAX, KALLAX, HEMNES, MALM, BESTA, BILLY and the full catalog. Flat rate per visit, not hourly.
- **Office Furniture Assembly**: office chairs, standing desks (Uplift, Fully, Autonomous, Vari, FlexiSpot, Branch, IKEA), L desks, workstations and cubicles, conference tables, filing cabinets, shelving, whiteboards and monitor arms for small offices, medical and dental practices, retail, coworking and home offices. Flat rate quoted per job from the unit count, evening and weekend installs, box breakdown included, certificates of insurance available, net 30 invoicing for business accounts. Page: alliancehandymanpros.com/office-furniture-assembly/
- **Grab Bar Installation**: anchored into studs or solid backing at ADA height, including tile and fiberglass surrounds. When you supply the bars: $235 for one bar, $299 for two, $449 for three, $699 for up to six. With bars we supply: $361 for two, $535 for three, $850 for up to six. Tile or stone adds $75 per bar.
- **Aging in Place**: grab bars, handrails, and threshold ramps so older adults can stay safe at home.
- **Childproofing and Baby Proofing**: furniture anchoring, baby gates, cabinet and outlet locks, corner guards. Starts at $199.
- **Bulb and Battery Service**: high ceiling light bulb replacement and smoke detector battery and unit replacement, residential and commercial.

## Pricing
Priced by the job, not by the hour, and confirmed before we start. Materials beyond standard hardware are quoted before the job. All prices are plus 8% sales tax. The small job minimum is $165. We are a cashless company: your card is pre-authorized 24 hours before the appointment and charged after the job is complete. There is no deposit. Cancellations made less than 24 hours in advance may incur a $75 fee. Most TV installs take 1 to 2 hours. Detailed cost guides are published at alliancehandymanpros.com/pricing for TV mounting, grab bar installation, IKEA assembly, and furniture assembly.

## Service Area
**Connecticut (Fairfield County):** Greenwich, Cos Cob, Old Greenwich, Riverside, Rowayton, Darien, New Canaan, Norwalk, Stamford, Westport, Weston, Wilton, Fairfield, Trumbull, Shelton, Monroe, Easton, Redding, Ridgefield.
**New York (Westchester County):** White Plains, Rye, Scarsdale, Larchmont, Mamaroneck, Harrison.

Each town has a dedicated page for TV mounting, furniture assembly, IKEA assembly, childproofing, aging in place, and grab bar installation at alliancehandymanpros.com.
